product_metadata.title: Maytex V-Hinged Glide Shower Curtain Hook, Oil Rubbed Bronze, 12 Pack
features: Engineered to stay on the rod
description: Make a big difference in your shower/tub when using these roller glide V-shaped shower hooks with a hinged opening. Engineered to stay on the rod when rolling across to open or close your shower curtain, these hooks will not fall upside down like other hook because of the shape. Made of durable coated stainless steel the curtain rings give a finishing touch to your bathroom decor. These roller hooks are rust resistant, friction free and glide smoothly on the curtain rod. Sold in sets of 12. Check out all the Maytex shower rings and hooks.
